paper.citation: Y. Zhu, X. Zhang, G. Zhang, "Mean relative intensity noise transfer in fiber Raman amplifiers using multiple-wavelength pumps," J. Lightwave Technol. 25(6), 1458-1465 (2007).

eq_7.description: Analytical RIN transfer for a single-wavelength counterpumped fiber Raman amplifier.

eq_6.description: Numerical mean RIN transfer, summed over pumps as |sum_j P_j^2(L) m_j(L)|^2 / P_eq^2(L).

pump_sets.pump_set_source: Zhu 2007 Section II and III text

fig1.description: Mean RIN transfer against frequency, 1e-2 to 1e2 kHz, for the six-wavelength counterpumped amplifier under three treatments.
fig1.dc_values_read_from: Fig. 1 rendered at 200 dpi. Dashed about +13 dB, solid about +5.3 dB, dotted about +6.8 dB.

virtual_vs_analytic_gap_db.note: Zhu 2007 reports the two one-pump RIN transfers are almost overlapped. The figure shows the numerical solid about 1.5 dB BELOW the analytic dotted.

real_vs_virtual_gap_db.note: The rise is attributed mainly to pump-to-pump RIN transfer among the uncorrelated pumps.

fig1.note: All values read by eye from Fig. 1 and treated as approximate.

eq7_verifiability.description: What about Zhu 2007 Eq. 7 can be checked against Fig. 1 without the paper's external references.

corner_frequency_verifiable.reason: The corner alpha_p * V_s / (4 pi) depends on the pump loss only weakly through alpha_p itself. For pump wavelengths 1425 to 1500 nm a standard fiber loss of 0.19 to 0.25 dB/km gives a corner between 0.6 and 0.9 kHz, matching the roll-off onset visible near 0.5 to 1 kHz in Fig. 1.
corner_frequency_verifiable.gate: corner within a factor of two of 1 kHz

rolloff_slope_verifiable.reason: Beyond the corner the response falls as 1/f in amplitude, i.e. 20 dB per decade. This is independent of alpha_p and of G_R.
rolloff_slope_verifiable.gate: slope within 3 dB per decade of 20 dB per decade, measured one decade past the corner

dc_level_verifiable.reason: Zhu 2007 does not state the fiber loss or the effective area. Its text reads 'The other measured parameters of the fiber are given in [11] and [12]', referring to T. Zhang, X. Zhang, and G. Zhang, 'Distributed fiber Raman amplifiers...'. The DC level ln(G_R)/(alpha_p L_eff) therefore cannot be evaluated from the paper alone, and the implementation returns about 1 dB for a nominal 0.19 dB/km pump loss against the about 6.8 dB read from Fig. 1.
dc_level_verifiable.resolution_required: Obtain refs [11] and [12] and their stated loss, or fit alpha_p once against Fig. 1 and record the fitted value with an explicit note that it was fitted.
dc_level_verifiable.do_not: Do not tune alpha_p to match the figure and then present Eq. 7 as verified. The corner and the roll-off slope are the verified parts.

acceptance.justification: Eq. 7 is gated on its corner frequency and roll-off slope, which are verifiable without the paper's external references, and NOT on its DC level, which is not. The DC is recorded as unresolved with the specific reference needed.
